noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

userUpdatable.description:
If set to `true` then the type can be modified by users and the modifications will be preserved even after upgrade
of the application.

notUserUpdatable.description:
By default fields are user updatable if the type is user updatable.  Set this field to true to "opt out" to
disallow user updates for the field if the type allows userUpdates.

userRemovable.description: If set to `true` then instance of type of application Seed Data can be removed / hidden by users.

notUserCreatable.description: If set to true then new instances of this type can not be created by users.

title:
Annotation for seed data behavior
